decisions.reason: The firm has visibly committed to this decorative carpet with its own product page, and it fits the established offer, so there is no reason yet to abandon a product launched only a year ago.
The hand-knotted wool silk carpet embodies the craftsmanship and fine materials the firm promotes, and that investment in sourcing and the public commitment favour persistence.
This collection piece is close to the core offer and has its own page, and any weak early sales can still be put down to the normal ramp-up time for new rugs.
The corner bench extends the established furniture range and is relevant to residential and hospitality projects, so its development investment justifies keeping it.
The low-pile carpet complements the rug portfolio at low ongoing cost, and the firm's public presentation of it encourages continuation.
As a multi-model chair line with significant tooling and design investment, the swivel shell chair is a strongly committed course of action that management will persist with.
